test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Seven people - B, D, F, K, M, Q and W are sitting in a straight line facing North. D sits second from one of the extreme ends of the line. Only two people sit between D and F. M sits fourth to the right of F. Q sits second to the right of W. K is not an immediate neighbour of W.

How many people sit to the left of B?
solution:
Given: Seven people - B, D, F, K, M, Q and W are sitting in a straight line facing North.

1) D sits second from one of the extreme ends of the line.

2) Only two people sit between D and F.

3) M sits fourth to the right of F. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b308474a294b18ec5470df1af2d818215d2cc05859e70e5906ce3ab860c06f0.png] 

4) Q sits second to the right of W.

5) K is not an immediate neighbour of W.

And, B sits at the remaining place. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63e55a5b58fd0bc405f931262ed1abbc2ea147e33e291af8711dbcc4b34c9a0a.png] 

Here, None of the people sits to the left of B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
